subject: MAP landing sprint — procurement deadline & dependency clarification
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@maplabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: landing sprint — target close & procurement checkpoints

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — good to see the MapLabs use case come to life. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and pulled the key milestones we discussed into a single timeline so we can align on owners and the critical procurement window.

High-level asks and proposed dates: 
- Proposed target close date (commercial go-live): 2026-09-30
- Procurement / contract signature deadline (for provisioning before go-live): 2026-10-07

Proposed milestones (initial owners listed):
1) Kickoff & SSO provisioning — target 2026-09-10 — Owner: MapLabs (Alex)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange — target 2026-09-15 — Owner: MapLabs (Sofia)
3) POC validation (3 days) — target 2026-09-20 — Owner: Redwood (Ben)
4) Legal review & redlines — target 2026-09-23 — Owner: MapLabs / Redwood (Dev)
5) Contract signature — target 2026-10-07 — Owner: MapLabs Procurement

If you have a hard procurement cut-off (e.g., month-end, blackout, or fiscal cycle) that forces sign-off earlier than 2026-10-07, please call that out so we can compress legal and POC gates accordingly.

Attachment: MapLabs_MAP_draft_v0.1.pdf (MAP draft)

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: confirm procurement sign-off deadline + procurement contact (by EOD)
- Sofia / procurement: confirm SOC2 items required and any evidence portal links
- Dev (legal): if we need to prioritize redlines, please flag availability

Thanks — I’ll hold on reworking the timeline until we know your hard deadline and procurement constraints.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0117
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@maplabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Lema <sofia.lema@maplabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: landing sprint — target close & procurement checkpoints

Evelyn,

Appreciate the recap and the MAP draft. A couple of immediate constraints from our side: 

1) Procurement monthly cutover: our finance team requires contracts to be fully executed before the September billing cut (internal cutoff is 2026-09-27). If the signature slips past that, the earliest provisioning gets pushed into October and spending approval timelines lengthen. 
2) I’m looping in our procurement lead, Sofia Lema (cc’d). Sofia, can you confirm the required evidence for SOC2 / retention and whether DocuSign is acceptable?

Given the above, our hard signature deadline is 2026-09-27. If Redwood can accelerate legal review (and the POC verification), we can target sign-off by that date.

Note: procurement@maplabs.com is the centralized mailbox for contracts — that is the owner for final signature routing. We can also get an exec approval window locked if Ben can share a short POC results brief.

DocuSign (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/embedded/abc123-maplabs-ds

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations | MapLabs
alex.rivera@maplabs.com | +1 415-555-2102

Thanks for the heads-up, Alex — noted on the 2026-09-27 signature deadline. I pushed an updated MAP layout attached (MapLabs_MAP_v0.2.pdf) that compresses the POC and legal windows so we can meet that date if internal resources align. Key changes:

- POC validation window shortened to 2 business days (target 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-19) — Redwood to deliver a one-page POC outcomes brief immediately after testing.
- Legal redline window moved up: initial redline pass by Redwood (Dev) by 2026-09-15; joint review 2026-09-16–2026-09-18.
- Contingency: if a full contract sign-off cannot be achieved by 2026-09-27, Redwood can offer temporary sandbox access and a scoped interim SOW to allow early integration testing.

Dev, are you able to commit to the earlier redline pass? If not, call out which clauses you need extended time on so we can flag them to MapLabs procurement.

Alex/Sofia — next asks from us to you: please confirm the hard signature owner (procurement@maplabs.com), and the specific SOC2 artifacts and retention period you need so we can attach them to the MAP.

Attachment: MapLabs_MAP_v0.2.pdf (updated MAP with compressed milestones)

Thanks,
